title: DVC (Data Version Control) — What it is
description: DVC (by Iterative) brings Git-style versioning to the big files Git can't handle: dvc add tracks a dataset with a tiny .dvc pointer file, remotes store the actual bytes on S3 or any cloud, and dvc.yaml + dvc.lock define reproducible pipelines whose stages re-run only when inputs change. dvc repro rebuilds an experiment; dvc exp run manages experiment variants. It is how ML projects stay reproducible as data grows. It is made by Iterative and runs on Windows, macOS, Linux (Python).
facts: dvc.yaml defines pipeline stages; dvc.lock records exact outputs and hashes.
dvc repro re-executes only stages whose dependencies changed.
Remotes can be S3, GCS, Azure, SSH or local disk.
